items.title: Is SanDisk Stock Amplifying A Risk You Already Own?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) has run up 23.3% over the last five trading days, while the S&P 500 added 2.4%. A move like that in a NAND maker pulls money in. But next week's price is not the question. What matters is what owning the stock does to your money when the market moves, because SanDisk travels much further than the index in both directions.

items.title: What Are You Really Paying For SanDisk's AI Flash Boom?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) stock has risen nearly 1,700% over the past year, even after falling 18% over the past three months to about 24% below its 52-week high. At a price near $1,770, it trades at about 22.7 times trailing adjusted earnings. That is normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back. Analysts' forecast earnings are defined differently. On forecast earnings, it looks far cheaper, if those earnings last.
